name: Widgi Creek
label: Widgi Creek
about_prose: Widgi Creek is a golf community on Bend's west side, set among Ponderosa pines along the rim of the Deschutes River Canyon on SW Century Drive. The Golf Club at Widgi Creek, an 18-hole public course designed by Robert Muir Graves and opened in 1991, anchors the community and has been voted Central Oregon's favorite public golf course by The Source readers more than 20 times.

Residential options include single-family homes and the Elkai Woods townhomes, which front the fairways and back to the Deschutes National Forest. The community sits about 5 miles southwest of downtown Bend on the road to Mt. Bachelor, giving residents direct access to year-round recreation along the corridor.

amenities.name: The Golf Club at Widgi Creek
amenities.description: 18-hole course by Robert Muir Graves, with bent-grass fairways and greens, tight tree-lined fairways, and undulating greens along the Deschutes River Canyon.

amenities.name: Practice Facility
amenities.description: Natural-grass driving range, two putting greens, and a practice bunker and chipping area.

amenities.name: The Grill
amenities.description: Full-service restaurant and bar in the clubhouse with an outdoor deck and banquet facilities up to 150.

amenities.name: Pickleball Courts
amenities.description: On-site pickleball with lessons available through the club.

amenities.name: Golf Instruction
amenities.description: Operation 36 Golf Academy and on-staff professionals offer lessons for all levels.
